import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Calculate average number of dogs per owner by owner age group
owner_age_avg = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang').agg(
    mean_dogs=('AnzHunde', 'mean'),
    sort_order=('AlterV10Sort', 'first')
).reset_index()

owner_age_avg = owner_age_avg.sort_values('sort_order')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.barplot(x='AlterV10Lang', y='mean_dogs', data=owner_age_avg, order=owner_age_avg['AlterV10Lang'])
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.title('Average Number of Dogs per Owner by Owner Age Group in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Owner Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Average Number of Dogs')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=15
